records.canonicalName: Nelson's Blood (cocktail) Named for vice admiral Horatio Viscount Nelson, Britain's most famous Naval hero, who was mortally wounded at the Battle of Trafalgar on October 21st, 1805. Legend has it that his body was returned in a cask of Pusser's rum and that the sailors bore a hole in the cask to get at the rum, thereby drinking "Nelson's Blood". We celebrate this bit of liquid history by blending 3 ounces of Pusser's Rum with cranberry, orange and pineapple juice topped off with a big squeeze of West Indian Lime, nutmeg and cinnamon.
